items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: Georgie Boyd had a tone like Edmund Hall too.

ctx.x: Did he play the same as he plays now? Almost. Almost. Would Zeb have a tone like him or more like yours? Zeb had a tone more like Edmund Hall. What about Georgie Boyd? What kind of tone did he have?
Georgie Boyd had a tone like Edmund Hall too.
Just checking on. Oh, when was the first time you ever heard Bunk to your knowledge?
